data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $75.1m (2019: $15.9m). Specialty lines and cyber & executive risk had releases of $37.5m and $7.0m respectively. Both specialty lines and cyber & executive risk have been impacted over the past few years by the increased claims seen on their liability books resulting in decreased releases. Action taken in the Marine division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the UK Marine portfolio in January 2020, have resulted in a release of $8.6m in the division. Both the property and reinsurance divisions have benefitted from releases on some of the 2019 natural catastrophe events, namely Storm Dorian in the US and Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai in Japan. The claims impact of the COVID-19 global pandemic is not included in the prior year reserve movements.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a gross prioryear reserves release of $75.1m in 2020 driven by favourable development and targeted remediation actions. Releases included $37.5m in Specialty Lines, $7.0m in Cyber & Executive Risk and an $8.6m release in Marine following remediation of selected portfolios. The Property and Reinsurance divisions also benefitted from releases relating to certain 2019 natural catastrophe events (Storm Dorian; Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai). The reported prior year movement excludes the claims impact of the COVID19 pandemic.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding prior-year column). Prior-year development figure ($75.1m) is taken from the narrative statement 'During 2020 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $75.1m' which is explicit but does not show a formal 'movement in prior year provision' reconciliation - treated as gross as presented. The report also contains gross and net claims development tables and a Part VII transfer note (transfer to Lloyd's Brussels on 30 Dec 2020) which the report states had no economic impact. Amounts are reported in the native currency (USD).
